# Nagrik Saathi

> A safe public-document copilot for Indian government notices. Paste or
> upload a notice (text, PDF, or photo) and get a plain-language brief in
> eight Indian languages, a scam-signal check, an action checklist, a
> review-only citizen letter draft, and links only to a human-reviewed
> registry of official government portals. All document processing happens
> on the device; nothing is uploaded for core flows; the app never logs in,
> pays, submits, or sends anything on the user's behalf.

## Understand a notice

- [Workspace](https://nagrik-saathi.vercel.app/): paste or attach a
  government notice and analyze the amount due, deadline, reference number,
  issuer, and required documents.
- [Tool playground](https://nagrik-saathi.vercel.app/playground): run any of
  the twelve agent tools locally and inspect its trust level, frequency hint,
  approval requirement, and JSON schema.

## Safety

- [Safety boundary](https://github.com/ashishpatill/nagrik-saathi/blob/master/docs/SAFETY.md):
  what the app refuses to do (no credentials, no payments, no automation,
  no model-supplied URLs).
- [Reviewed portal registry](https://github.com/ashishpatill/nagrik-saathi/blob/master/src/data/official-portals.ts):
  the only source of official links; every entry is HTTPS and human-reviewed.

## Agent surface

- WebMCP tools are registered on the home page via `document.modelContext`.
  The same twelve-tool registry powers the playground and the MCP server.
  Read-only: `find_official_portal`, `verify_portal_url`, `redact_pii`.
  Untrusted-content: `get_notice_summary`, `check_scam_signals`,
  `analyze_notice`, `create_action_plan`, `draft_citizen_letter`,
  `translate_brief`, `generate_checklist_document`.
  Side-effect, browser-only, approval required: `schedule_reminder`,
  `export_family_brief`.
- Tool inputs are treated as untrusted. Portal links come only from the
  reviewed registry; `verify_portal_url` returns the registry URL, never a
  model-supplied URL as official.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/ashishpatill/nagrik-saathi/blob/master/mcp/README.md):
  TypeScript server sharing the same tool logic. Ten read-only tools over
  stdio or Streamable HTTP. Local only today; no public endpoint is deployed.
  It is not an on-device surface when run remotely.
- [Agent Card](https://nagrik-saathi.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-card.json):
  A2A skeleton only. No A2A endpoint is deployed; do not treat it as a live
  agent.

## Repository

- [Source code](https://github.com/ashishpatill/nagrik-saathi): Next.js +
  TypeScript, deterministic extraction, vitest-tested trust rules.
